# The OLT side of one ISP2 provisioning session, from cold boot to the last
# service: one baseline OMCI frame per line, for src/omci/drv-test.sh.
# Rebuilt from the omcid log of that session by
# src/omci/tools/session-from-log.py: the log keeps the first 16 bytes of
# each message contents (20 for a GemPortCtp create), so the rest are zero
# unless restored below, and a get carries the mask of its answer. CRC zero.
# Restored (the "# restored" lines below, offsets in the contents):
#   t32786-t32789@16  the four ExtVlan rules: treatment inner VID 4096 TPID 0,
#               as a MIB readback of the same stick shows;
#   t32781@16   the eighth p-bit pointer of the mapper set that names one IW
#               TP for p-bits 0-6: the same one;
#   130/4@16    the eighth p-bit pointer of the mapper create: null, like the
#               seven logged.
# Scrubbed: nothing to withhold in this session (no credential, address or
# OltG message).
# Regenerated only from a session log; a frame is not edited by hand.
# restored: 130/4@16=ffff (1 message)
# restored: t32781@16=1001 (1 message)
# restored: t32786@16=8000 (1 message)
# restored: t32787@16=8000 (1 message)
# restored: t32788@16=8000 (1 message)
# restored: t32789@16=8000 (1 message)
